Claude Code Changelog

Synthetic fixture for Primitive D Phase 0 test surface (shape §4.5.6). Each <h2> heading below is a feature announcement; the paragraph that follows carries optional Tier: and Affected primitives: hints the deterministic extractor recognises.

--system-prompt-file flag for interactive + print sessions

A new --system-prompt-file flag lands in 2.1.114, extending beyond print-only. Tier: S. Affected primitives: B, G. This replaces the default system prompt in every launched session, closing the gap the steward has been synthesizing via .claude/agents/ files.

Native Agent Teams primitive preview

Opt-in via CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS. Tier: A. Affected primitives: B. Supports session-ephemeral teammate dispatch; does not persist across restarts. See --agent-teams-config for setup.

Plugin registry index expands

Tier: B. Affected primitives: D. The official plugin registry now publishes a daily index of community plugins; this is an additional source for the changelog-review scraper to walk.

PostToolUse hook: tool_call_succeeded event

Tier: B. Affected primitives: A. A new hook event fires after every successful tool call, carrying the tool name and redacted args. This is an alternative to the existing ad-hoc per-hook event emission used by the steward fleet.
